# Kuyfi

> Black-box security terminal for Soroban smart contracts on Stellar Testnet.
> Tagline: Before the Breach.
> Site: https://kuyfi.vercel.app
> Docs: https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs
> npm: @kuyfi/kuyfi (CLI command: kuyfi)
> GitHub: https://github.com/alex0tico/kuyfi
> Version: 0.1.0 · License: MIT · Network: Stellar Testnet only

Kuyfi analyzes deployed Soroban contracts from their on-chain interface (WASM + contractspecv0). No Rust source required. It reconstructs the attack surface, runs type-aware Chaos Monkey fuzzing (simulate first; broadcast to Testnet only when preflight succeeds), classifies DiagnosticEvent traces into six signals, and exports a SecurityReport as JSON/PDF.

## Markdown for Agents (NOT MDX)

MDX = Markdown + JSX components (UI authoring). That is NOT the agent format.

Kuyfi ships plain Markdown for LLMs — same idea as Cloudflare Docs:

- Copy as Markdown / View as Markdown on every HTML docs page (Page options)
- Per-page Markdown: https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/md/<slug>.md
- This file (llms.txt) + https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/llms-full.txt
- Setup guide: https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/agent-setup

```bash
curl -sL https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/md/index.md
curl -sL https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/md/chaos-monkey.md
```

## Critical constraints for agents

- Testnet only (RPC https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org). No Mainnet support in v0.1.0.
- Findings are signals to investigate, not confirmed exploits or certifications.
- Only fuzz contracts the user owns or is authorized to test.
- Paid HTTP API exposes OSINT scan only — never Chaos Monkey.
- Ephemeral Friendbot keypairs; secrets are not persisted.
- MCP: connect path is https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/mcp#connect (“Conectar el MCP al server de Kuyfi”). Package @kuyfi/mcp may still be coming soon — JSON config on that page is the stable contract.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g @kuyfi/kuyfi
kuyfi
kuyfi <CONTRACT_ID> --json --pdf
```

Contract ID shape: /^C[A-Z0-9]{55}$/

## Pipeline

Contract ID → OSINT Scanner (fetch WASM) → Reconstruct attack surface → Chaos Monkey (type-aware vectors) → Simulate & classify → JSON/PDF SecurityReport (schemaVersion 1.0.0)

## Optional paid scan server

```bash
# PAY_TO=G... public address only
kuyfi-server
# GET /scan/:contractId → 402 then 200 with scan surface
```
